sections.heading: The Mandate: $130M by 2030
sections.narrative: Achieving our revenue target requires a bifurcated strategy. We must protect our existing Alternative Cloud Provider (ACP) and Managed Service Provider (MSP) base against pricing pressure from hyperscalers and vendors like Wasabi, while aggressively penetrating the cloud-native and AI infrastructure markets. We win on bundled economics, multi-tenant sovereignty, and proven performance.
sections.quote: "Data readiness is the main factor contributing to the gap between AI ambition and AI achievement... over half of organizations report that their data is not AI-ready." - Gartner, 2024

sections.heading: Market Calibration (2026-2027)
sections.narrative: Our Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM) is strictly calculated at 15% of the global Total Addressable Market (TAM), representing the specific ACP/MSP segments where we compete, entirely excluding captive hyperscaler workloads.

data.logic: Assumes 40 partners adopt GPU-tier at 5PB with $5/TB premium.
Assumes 30% of MSP base implements stricter S3 Cost API controls.
Assumes 100 partners deploy managed K8s clusters on bare-metal.
Assumes 120 partners adopt archival tiers to compete with Wasabi.

sections.heading: Execution: Product & Engineering Sync
sections.narrative: The 2026-2027 roadmap aligns product monetization scenarios with critical engineering stepping stones to ensure architectural viability at petabyte scale.

scenarios: Aligned Tenant Isolation with Compute (Sub-tenant resale)
engineering_enablers: S3 Bucket Scalability for high object counts
Enhanced recovery from dirty chunks for EC LSM
timeline.business_impact: Unlocks the ability for MSPs to accurately meter, isolate, and charge for subsequent high-margin tiers.

scenarios: High-performance S3 backend for vLLM Distributed Training
timeline.business_impact: Penetrates the $975M SAM by targeting ML pipelines, charging a 1.5x–2.0x premium for the GPU-optimized tier.

scenarios: K8s compliant CSI for PaaS architectures
engineering_enablers: New storage backend for S3 services (per-stripe layout)
timeline.business_impact: Directly counters Wasabi's price pressure and targets the bare-metal Kubernetes market to replace Ceph/Portworx.

scenarios: Decoupled edge caching to eliminate retrieval bottlenecks
timeline.business_impact: Eliminates egress bottlenecks and solidifies enterprise Kubernetes backup adoption.

sections.heading: The GTM Shift: Benchmark-as-a-Service (BaaS)
sections.narrative: We must change our sales motion. Instead of competing on static datasheets against hyperscaler marketing budgets, we propose launching Benchmark-as-a-Service. Using our continuous internal benchmarking dataset, an Agentic AI will allow customers to input their exact workload requirements and instantly receive a validated reference architecture.

sections.heading: Experimental R&D: Native Data Versioning
sections.narrative: To capture the next generation of AI and data-engineering workloads, we are evaluating merging our object storage backend with Git-like principles, similar to the LakeFS architecture. As massive unstructured datasets become the foundation for Innovative Use Cases (like autonomous robotic training and LLM fine-tuning), reproducibility is mandatory.
points: Zero-Copy Branching: Data engineers can branch petabytes of training data instantaneously without duplicating storage consumption.
Atomic Commits & Rollbacks: Complete protection against data corruption during distributed model training.
CI/CD for Data: Enables automated validation of datasets before they are merged into production inferencing models.

sections.heading: Appendix & Proof Points
sections.narrative: Industry validation and strategic research underpinning the 2026-2027 Virtuozzo Storage roadmap.
points: Gartner (2024): The market for AI-ready data infrastructure is projected to more than double by 2027, validating our $6.5B GPU/AI SAM and the prioritization of S3 RDMA integrations.

CNCF Cloud Native Survey: Persistent storage remains a top barrier for stateful Kubernetes workloads, highlighting the urgency for our operator-friendly bare-metal CSI driver to displace complex Ceph deployments.
Data Versioning in MLOps: Organizations adopting architectures like LakeFS report up to 80% reduction in storage costs for duplicate ML training environments through zero-copy branching.

Pricing Pressures: Wasabi and Backblaze continue to capture the MSP tier through egress-free modeling. Our Keystone-aligned Multi-Tenancy and Cost API are strict prerequisites to enabling our ACPs to counter this with predictable, multi-tier economics.
